Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 11 (test build)

Release 11 locks your vault when its host goes silent and tightens what a vault's process may do inside the enclave.

The current release. New vaults are enrolled into it, and the app offers it to everyone on an older release.

Changes

  • If the host your vault runs on stops answering for two minutes, your vault now locks itself. Unlock it again with your PIN; nothing is lost.
  • Hardening: the process that runs your vault inside the enclave is refused more of the system functions it never needs, and can no longer create a private system environment of its own. Every release is tested for this on real hardware before it is offered.
  • The enclave is built with a newer version of its programming language, which includes fixes to the network and encryption code it uses.
  • Fix: a vault whose stored state had grown very large could be saved but not read back. The host now reads everything it can write.
  • Fewer and steadier connections between vaults and the relay. Nothing changes in how your messages are delivered.

Security

Security fix: update recommended (affects releases 7, 8, 9, 10)

Release 11 closes ways in which a fault in one vault's process could have reached beyond that vault inside the enclave, and updates the enclave's network and encryption code to a version with security fixes. We know of no use of either against any vault. Your PIN and credential password were not exposed.
